title: SkillsRegistry
description: Schema definition for the favorite agent skills installer registry

version.description: Semantic version of the registry format

skills.description: Dictionary of skills keyed by skill identifier

id.description: Unique key or slug for the skill (e.g. gsd-core)

description.description: Brief explanation of what the skill provides

category.description: Category or functional domain (e.g. workflow, engineering, context-optimization)

repository.description: Official GitHub repository or project documentation URL

npxSkills.description: Commands using the official Skills CLI (`npx skills add`)

supported.description: Whether npx skills add is supported

local.description: Command to install into current project

specificExample.description: Example command to install an individual sub-skill

notes.description: Additional notes for the npx skills method

npxSkillInstall.description: Command using the shorthand `npx skill install` format if supported

supported.description: Whether npx skill install is supported directly

command.description: The exact npx skill install command

customCommands.description: Custom installation commands or alternative package installers

name.description: Human-readable label for this installation method

command.description: Terminal command string for user to copy and run

recommended.description: Whether this is the recommended primary method

description.description: Explanation of what this command does

postInstall.description: Suggested post-install setup commands, doctor checks, or slash commands
